usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the Proxmox subscription status and node health details (CPU, memory, rootfs, kernel, PVE version) for a specific node on a managed PVE remote. The caller must have Resource.Audit privilege on the target remote/node path. Note: despite the endpoint name referencing 'subscription', the response schema returns node system status fields rather than a subscription key or tier — treat the response as a combined node-status object and check additionalProperties for any subscription-specific fields.

examples.summary: Get subscription/status details for node 'pve1' on remote 'hetzner-prod'

tips: The remote name must match the exact ID registered in PDM (2–32 chars, alphanumeric/dash/dot/underscore).
Use 'localhost' as the node value only when PDM itself is the target node.
The returns schema includes additionalProperties:true — subscription-tier fields (e.g., status, level, key) may appear beyond what is documented in the spec.
Cross-reference with the node status endpoint if you need real-time metrics; this endpoint's primary intent is the subscription record.
